The Shell: The letterforms are Hollow Containers with open faces or glass walls. They act like terrariums or shadow boxes. Elevators, vines, or ladders should climb up the vertical strokes. 4. Visual Syntax: Scale: Tilt-Shift Focus. Blur the background to make the letters look like tangible miniature models. Detail: High-frequency textures. We need to see individual leaves, bricks, or rivets. 5. Lighting: Internal Glow: The letters are lit from within by the bioluminescence or streetlights of the micro-world. External Sun: A soft studio key light highlights the rim of the letter casing. items.title: Cinematic Disintegration Portrait Prompt
items.prompt: Create an ultra-realistic, cinematic 8K image with high-contrast dramatic lighting and a photo-real digital painting aesthetic-use face reference exactly. The man is shown in a full-body side profile facing right, his face and hairstyle copied perfectly with no alterations He wears modern casual streetwear; a light grey crewneck t-shirt, light neutral cargo pants, light-colored high-top boots, and a watch on his left wrist. His posture is slightly slumped, head bowed, eyes looking downward, hands relaxed at his sides, conveying deep introspection and sorrow. Nearly half of his body is dissolving into extremely thick, cloud-like grey smoke filled with glowing yellow dust particles. His left arm, shoulder, torso, legs, and part of his hair become transparent as they break into luminous particles, suggesting active disintegration Behind and partially surrounding him is a massive glowing crescent (C-shaped) energy aura, emitting fiery golden-white plasma light. This aura acts as a powerful rim and backlight, highlighting the smoke, dust, and silhouette. The setting is minimal and stark: a concrete or desolate paved surface meeting a heavily overcast sky. The color palette is nearly monochrome greys and whites, contrasted by intense amber-gold glow, Shallow depth of field, glow/bloom lighting, particle dispersion, cinematic composition, emotional and dramatic atmosphere.

items.title: Lifestyle Yoga Indoor Portrait
items.prompt: Create a photorealistic lifestyle portrait of A young woman relaxing indoors in a comfortable home setting. She has shoulder-length, softly tousled {argument name="hair color" default="light brown/blonde"} hair, parted near the center, with a few natural strands framing her face. Her complexion is fair with realistic natural skin texture and subtle warm undertones. She has softly defined facial features, natural eyebrows, light-colored eyes, and a calm, composed expression while looking directly toward the camera. Pose: She is seated comfortably on a {argument name="mat color" default="pink"} exercise/yoga mat on a light wooden floor, with her knees naturally raised and her hands resting beside her for balance. The composition should emphasize a relaxed, candid at-home lifestyle moment rather than a fashion pose. Use natural, anatomically correct proportions and a comfortable posture. Clothing: She wears a coordinated {argument name="outfit color" default="sky-blue"} athletic outfit, consisting of a fitted long-sleeve or short-sleeve athletic top and matching high-waisted leggings with realistic fabric texture and subtle stitching. She wears simple white open-toe sandals and a delicate minimalist necklace. Keep the styling tasteful, casual, and suitable for a wellness/lifestyle photograph. Environment: A bright, modern apartment interior with warm wooden flooring, cream-colored walls, white paneled doors, and built-in cabinetry. A small dark handbag hangs neatly on a wall hook in the background. The pink yoga mat provides a subtle accent against the neutral interior. Keep the background clean and realistic with believable household details. Lighting: Soft natural daylight entering from nearby windows, combined with gentle warm indoor illumination. Use realistic highlights and soft shadows across the subject and room. Maintain balanced exposure, natural skin tones, subtle reflections on the wooden floor, and realistic fabric highlights. Camera & style: Photorealistic editorial lifestyle photography, 35mm lens, low but natural camera perspective, medium-wide vertical composition, eye-level facial focus, realistic depth of field, crisp facial details, natural skin texture, subtle lens characteristics, high dynamic range, cinematic but realistic color grading, soft contrast, professional photography, ultra-detailed environment, authentic proportions, no artificial plastic skin.

items.title: Detailed Yacht Lifestyle Photography
items.prompt: A {argument name="subject" default="confident adult male"} stands at the center-right of the frame, facing the camera with shifted weight and level shoulders. He features a {argument name="facial hair" default="neatly trimmed dark beard"} with natural density variations and short, stylish brown hair. He wears an {argument name="outfit" default="unbuttoned white linen shirt, light beige trousers, and matching suede loafers"}. A subtle, closed smile graces his face as his left hand is raised, with the index finger and thumb lightly gripping the frame of his dark sunglasses, his fingers curling naturally. His right hand rests relaxed inside his front right trouser pocket with the thumb visibly exposed. He is positioned in the foreground on a pristine luxury yacht staircase, featuring warm brown teak wood treads detailed with black striped rubber caulking, bordered by perfectly smooth, glossy bright white fiberglass risers, curved stainless steel handrails, and a dark tinted glass window to the right. The midground opens up on the left half to thriving, choppy ocean water, leading into a deep background featuring a dominant suspension bridge with tall towers and cables spanning from the top center to the top right, alongside a mid-right cityscape of buildings clustered on rolling coastal hills. The scene is bathed in a cheerful, breezy, and aspirational late afternoon atmosphere, driven by bright, highly directional warm golden sunlight beaming from the back-left. This single natural light source provides hard light with atmospheric diffusion, creating a split-complementary palette dominated by crisp whites, ocean blues, light beiges, and warm teak. Harsh, defined gray shadows are cast forward and to the right, prominently visible on the wooden steps beneath the subject, while softer shadows beautifully wrap across his body. Intense specular highlights blow out the water surface on the left and create a strong rim light along the yacht's left edges and stainless steel handrails. This tack sharp, grain-free digital lifestyle photograph captures a realistic, clean aesthetic shot from an eye-level perspective. Emulating a full-frame camera with a 35mm or 50mm lens at f/8, a 1/500s shutter speed, and ISO 100, the deep depth of field keeps both the subject and the distant bridge in crisp focus. Post-processing enhances the high contrast, lifts the shadows on the subject's front to compensate for the backlighting, and increases the overall golden warmth while preserving the specular water reflections, all seamlessly framed in a 3:4 aspect ratio.

items.title: Nano Banana Pro Prompting Strategy for Stable Output
items.prompt: ① Always switch the mode to 'Thought' or 'Pro' (I feel 'Thought' is better) ② 'Describe the scene in sentences' rather than listing keywords ③ Specify the subject, background, and atmosphere as a set of three points ④ Don't aim for perfection in one go; apply 'gradual corrections' ⑤ Avoid negative expressions; give instructions in positive sentences ⑥ Add quality keywords (4K, high resolution) in English ⑦ Clearly state the purpose at the beginning (e.g., "{argument name="purpose" default="Diagram for a proposal"}") ⑧ Exclude unnecessary elements using negative prompts ⑨ Do not attempt complex edits all at once; proceed in segments ⑩ Save frequently used prompts as templates
